* [http://mechon-mamre.org/p/pt/pt0104.htm#25 Genesis 4:25-26]
* [http://mechon-mamre.org/p/pt/pt0105.htm#3 Genesis 5:3-8] lists his place in the ten generations between Adam & Noah. Normally genealogies are traced by the first-born sons, but Cain killed Abel and then was banished, so Seth became almost like a new “first-born”.

Wikipedia:
* [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seth Seth] and [http://he.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D7%A9%D7%AA שת].
* [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seth#Islam Seth in Islam.]

Seth, 3rd son of Adam & Eve, was born after Cain murdered Abel. So the family line is continued through him. His name denoted this being derived from the root meaning "appointed-given" instead of his brother(s), as Eve herself explains.
